summary: SOS Limited filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, confirming the September 28, 2026 closing of a previously disclosed private placement to certain non-U.S. persons under a September 24, 2026 securities purchase agreement. No price per share, share count, stake percentage, or aggregate proceeds are stated in the excerpt. No board recommendation, advisor, or break fee is named. The event is a routine capital-raising consummation rather than a special situation, so deal terms are absent and the main watch item is the eventual pricing and dilution disclosure.
